about_the_game:
Pirate Go: Bravo is a thrilling turn-based pirate-themed strategy game inspired by the classic mechanics of Monopoly. Set sail across a vibrant archipelago where every dice roll decides your fate—will you land on a treasure island, a rival's stronghold, or trigger a mysterious event?

Build your empire by acquiring islands, collecting tolls, and expanding your maritime domain. Each game is a unique blend of luck and tactics, where your decisions shape your rise as the ultimate pirate tycoon. Face off against other pirates, defend your territory, and seize opportunities to outmaneuver your opponents.

Uncover legendary treasures hidden throughout the map by collecting keys and unlocking mysterious chests. Upgrade your fleet, strengthen your economy, and chart your path to domination of the high seas.
